[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Infravision: see in the dark.

Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger

[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2

EN:
Background component allows defining an RGB background [color=192,176,27,255]color[/color] and optionally a walking sound ([color=192,176,27,255]noise[/color]) for entities that enter the tile. It is commonly used by lowest tiles on the map without Position2D component and different collidable entities like walls. Noise can have [color=192,176,27,255]intensity[/color] defined which determines how much noise someone will make when walking the tile.

Required components: Name.
PTBR:
O componente de plano de fundo permite definir uma [color=192,176,27,255]cor[/color] de fundo RGB e opcionalmente um som de passos ([color=192,176,27,255]ruído[/color]) para entidades que entram no quadrado. É comumente usado pelos quadrados mais baixos do mapa sem componente Position2D e diferentes entidades colidíveis como paredes. O ruído pode ter [color=192,176,27,255]intensidade[/color] definida, o que determina quanto ruído alguém fará ao andar no quadrado.

Componentes necessários: Nome.

EN:
Chain multiple entities together to work as a single multi-tile entity.
[color=192,176,27,255]Leader[/color] defines if specific bodypart is leader. Leader drives the movement, and when killed, kills entire entity.
[color=192,176,27,255]Snake[/color] snake bodyparts move into the previous bodypart in the list movement position on move.
[color=192,176,27,255]Main Body[/color] entity also dies if main body is killed.
[color=192,176,27,255]Regrow Delay[/color] time (in turns) after which the specific body part regrow.
[color=192,176,27,255]Regrow Multiplier[/color] if regrow multiplier is bigger then 1, then regrow will trigger more bodyparts, and more parts will grow at once. Limit is (body party count) * (multiplier). Extra parts need space near the leader or mainbody to work.

Required components: Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
Encadeie várias entidades para funcionarem como uma única entidade que ocupa vários quadrados.
[color=192,176,27,255]Líder[/color] define se uma parte do corpo específica é o líder. O líder comanda o movimento e, quando morto, mata a entidade inteira.
[color=192,176,27,255]Cobra[/color] as partes do corpo da cobra movem-se para a posição de movimento da parte anterior na lista ao mover.
[color=192,176,27,255]Corpo Principal[/color] a entidade também morre se o corpo principal for morto.
[color=192,176,27,255]Atraso de Regeneração[/color] tempo (em turnos) após o qual a parte do corpo específica se regenera.
[color=192,176,27,255]Multiplicador de Regeneração[/color] se o multiplicador de regeneração for maior que 1, o regeneração acionará mais partes do corpo, e mais partes crescerão de uma vez. O limite é (contagem de partes do corpo) * (multiplicador). Partes extras precisam de espaço perto do líder ou do corpo principal para funcionar.

Componentes necessários: Position2D, Name.

EN:
Entity with this component requires food and drink. The actual consumption may differ depending on the race. For example, vampires consume blood, while liches feed on death damage dealt. Race for entities other than the player may be decided based on Tag component.

Required components: Actor, Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
Entidade com este componente requer comida e bebida. O consumo real pode variar dependendo da raça. Por exemplo, vampiros consomem sangue, enquanto liches se alimentam de dano de Morte causado. A raça para entidades que não sejam o jogador pode ser decidida com base no componente Tag.

Componentes necessários: Actor, Position2D, Name.

Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger
race.name: Rasimi

EN:
Container allows entity to hold something in a limited or unlimited volume. Currently only liquid container [color=192,176,27,255]type[/color] is supported. Capacity determines how many units of selected type can be held in the container, where -1 defines unlimited amount.

Required components: Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
Um recipiente permite que a entidade armazene algo em volume limitado ou ilimitado. Atualmente, só há suporte ao [color=192,176,27,255]tipo[/color] de recipiente para líquidos. A capacidade determina quantas unidades do tipo selecionado podem ser armazenadas, sendo que -1 indica quantidade ilimitada.

Componentes necessários: Position2D, Nome.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Fishing rod

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.
Tinkerer: double chance to learn new recipe when salvaging.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Pickaxe

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Rags
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow

[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. EN:
Defines resources, tools and workstations required to create the entity. Only entities with this component can be crafted. Under [color=192,176,27,255]tools[/color] field, select tools and workstations required to make this entity. [color=192,176,27,255]Time[/color] defines the number of turns to create the item. [color=192,176,27,255]Resources[/color] represent a list of [color=192,176,27,255]entities[/color] with their [color=192,176,27,255]amounts[/color] that will be consumed to create the entity with this component.[color=192,176,27,255]Category Id[/color] represents to which building category in building panel this entity belongs.

Required components: Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
Define os recursos, as ferramentas e as estações de trabalho necessárias para criar a entidade. Somente entidades com este componente podem ser fabricadas. No campo [color=192,176,27,255]tools[/color], selecione as ferramentas e estações de trabalho necessárias para fabricar esta entidade. [color=192,176,27,255]Tempo[/color] define o número de turnos para criar o item. [color=192,176,27,255]Recursos[/color] representa uma lista de [color=192,176,27,255]entidades[/color] com suas [color=192,176,27,255]quantidades[/color], que serão consumidas para criar a entidade com este componente. [color=192,176,27,255]ID da Categoria[/color] indica a categoria à qual esta entidade pertence no painel de construção.

Componentes necessários: Position2D, Nome.

EN:
This component causes damage to be applied when entity with Moveable component enters the tile. It can be useful for traps. It can be configured to apply damage over time effect.
[color=192,176,27,255]Damage[/color] is a range of damage dealt on trigger.
[color=192,176,27,255]Type[/color] defines type of damage dealt.
[color=192,176,27,255]Duration[/color] applies to damage over time, the damage effect will persist for determined number of turns.
[color=192,176,27,255]Tick every[/color] defies how often a damage should be applied.
[color=192,176,27,255]Animation[/color] is the selected animation that will play when entity triggers the damage.
[color=192,176,27,255]Destroy on trigger[/color] determines if entity with this component should be destroyed when damage triggers or stay on map and trigger again.

Required components: Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
Este componente faz com que dano seja aplicado quando uma entidade com o componente Moveable entra no quadrado. Pode ser útil para armadilhas. Pode ser configurado para aplicar efeito de dano ao longo do tempo.
[color=192,176,27,255]Dano[/color] é uma faixa de dano causado no gatilho.
[color=192,176,27,255]Tipo[/color] define o tipo de dano causado.
[color=192,176,27,255]Duração[/color] aplica-se a dano ao longo do tempo, o efeito de dano persistirá por um número determinado de turnos.
[color=192,176,27,255]Pulso a cada[/color] define com que frequência o dano deve ser aplicado.
[color=192,176,27,255]Animação[/color] é a animação selecionada que será reproduzida quando a entidade acionar o dano.
[color=192,176,27,255]Destruir no gatilho[/color] determina se a entidade com este componente deve ser destruída quando o dano é acionado ou permanecer no mapa e acionar novamente.

Componentes obrigatórios: Position2D, Name.

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.
Tinkerer: double chance to learn new recipe when salvaging.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Pickaxe

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Rags
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags
race.name: Goblin

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak
race.name: Vampire

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Club
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Club
race.name: Troll

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger
race.name: Rasimi

EN:
This component determines if an entity can be aggressive. Entities without a fighter component will only attempt to run away, which may be common behavior for smaller animals, for example. Names of unarmed attack types can be specified under [color=192,176,27,255]Attack names[/color]. If no attacks are specified then default names are Fist, Kick, Elbow, Knee, so make sure non-humanoid entities have more fitting names of attacks.

Required components: Actor, Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
Este componente determina se uma entidade pode ser agressiva. Entidades sem componente de lutador apenas tentarão fugir, comportamento comum para animais menores, por exemplo. Nomes de tipos de ataque desarmados podem ser especificados em [color=192,176,27,255]Nomes de ataques[/color]. Se nenhum ataque for especificado, os nomes padrão são Punho, Chute, Cotovelada, Joelhada, então certifique-se de que entidades não-humanoides tenham nomes de ataques mais adequados.

Componentes obrigatórios: Actor, Position2D, Name.

[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. [color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. [color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. EN:
Glyph component is a representation of the entity on the game screen. Pick one of the available symbols and use sliders to select RGB [color=192,176,27,255]color[/color]. Glyphs support animations, you can pick a frame and input time in milliseconds before next frame will appear. Press right mouse click to remove the frame. At least one frame is required for Glyph component to be valid.

Required components: Name.
PTBR:
O componente Glifo é uma representação da entidade na tela do jogo. Escolha um dos símbolos disponíveis e use os controles deslizantes para selecionar a [color=192,176,27,255]cor[/color] RGB. Glifos suportam animações; você pode escolher um quadro e inserir o tempo em milissegundos antes que o próximo quadro apareça. Clique com o botão direito do mouse para remover o quadro. Pelo menos um quadro é necessário para que o componente Glifo seja válido.

Componentes necessários: Nome.

EN:
Glyph top determines multiple glyphs that are rendered on top of current entity. An example use case is leaves on trees and bushes. You can select multiple glyphs and define multiple [color=192,176,27,255]colors[/color] which will be picked randomly during world generation. The [color=192,176,27,255]count[/color] field determines number of glyphs that will spawn.
[color=192,176,27,255]Max range[/color] is the max radius from the center of tile.
[color=192,176,27,255]Wind[/color] determines if glyphs should be moved around depending on wind direction and strength.
[color=192,176,27,255]Alpha[/color] determines transparency of all glyphs with range between 0 to 255.

Required components: Glyph, Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
O topo do glifo determina vários glifos que são renderizados sobre a entidade atual. Um exemplo de uso são folhas em árvores e arbustos. Você pode selecionar vários glifos e definir várias [color=192,176,27,255]cores[/color] que serão escolhidas aleatoriamente durante a geração do mundo. O campo [color=192,176,27,255]contagem[/color] determina o número de glifos que surgirão.
[color=192,176,27,255]Alcance máximo[/color] é o raio máximo a partir do centro do quadrado.
[color=192,176,27,255]Vento[/color] determina se os glifos devem ser movidos dependendo da direção e força do vento.
[color=192,176,27,255]Alfa[/color] determina a transparência de todos os glifos com intervalo entre 0 a 255.

Componentes obrigatórios: Glifo, Position2D, Nome.

EN:
Health component make the entity destructible. In the [color=192,176,27,255]health[/color] enter how much damage the entity can take before it's destroyed. If [color=192,176,27,255]Position2D[/color] is not assigned to the entity, the [color=192,176,27,255]health[/color] value will always be 1. Other fields of damage type determine entity (often corpse) that will be created when this entity will be destroyed. If you would like to have a single entity independent of damage type dealt, pick a corpse under [color=192,176,27,255]Any[/color] damage type. [color=192,176,27,255]Can Regenerate Health[/color] checkbox can be unchecked to disabled natural over time regeneration of actor entity.

Required components: Name
PTBR:
O componente de Vida torna a entidade destrutível. No campo [color=192,176,27,255]Vida[/color], insira quanto dano a entidade pode receber antes de ser destruída. Se o [color=192,176,27,255]Position2D[/color] não for atribuído à entidade, o valor de [color=192,176,27,255]Vida[/color] será sempre 1. Os outros campos de tipo de dano determinam a entidade (geralmente cadáver) que será criada quando esta entidade for destruída. Se você quiser ter uma única entidade independente do tipo de dano recebido, escolha um cadáver sob o tipo de dano [color=192,176,27,255]Qualquer[/color]. A caixa de seleção [color=192,176,27,255]Pode Regenerar Vida[/color] pode ser desmarcada para desativar a regeneração natural ao longo do tempo da entidade ator.

Componentes obrigatórios: Nome

EN:
Height component defines how high the entity is when displayed in 3d mode. It's a used to display walls, trees, tables and other stuff. If the entity has a [color=192,176,27,255]Background[/color] component, that component will be used to determine height. If entity doesn't have it, then [color=192,176,27,255]Glyph[/color] component is used.

Required components: Position2D, Name, Background or Glyph
PTBR:
O componente Altura define o quão alta a entidade é quando exibida no modo 3D. Ele é usado para exibir paredes, árvores, mesas e outros objetos. Se a entidade tiver um componente [color=192,176,27,255]Plano de fundo[/color], esse componente será usado para determinar a altura. Se a entidade não o tiver, então o componente [color=192,176,27,255]Glifo[/color] será usado.

Componentes obrigatórios: Position2D, Nome, Plano de fundo ou Glifo

[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet

[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.

[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. Infravision: see in the dark.

EN:
Name is a required component for every entity. [color=192,176,27,255]Name[/color] field should be the entity name, while the description is the extra details to help players imagine what they see.
[color=192,176,27,255]Description[/color] may be generated procedurally if you enter 'Placeholder' into the description and certain conditions are met. Entity requires a certain tag to have a description generated too. Supported tags are Demon, Dwarf, Elf, Fishman, Goblin, Human, Lich, Orc, Rasimi, Reptilion, Satyr, and Troglodyte.

Required components: None.
PTBR:
Nome é um componente obrigatório para toda entidade. [color=192,176,27,255]Nome[/color] deve ser o nome da entidade, enquanto a descrição são os detalhes extras para ajudar os jogadores a imaginar o que veem.
[color=192,176,27,255]Descrição[/color] pode ser gerada proceduralmente se você inserir 'Placeholder' na descrição e certas condições forem atendidas. A entidade precisa de uma tag específica para ter uma descrição gerada também. Tags suportadas: Demônio, Anão, Elfo, Homem-peixe, Goblin, Humano, Lich, Orc, Rasimi, Reptilion, Sátiro e Troglodita.

Componentes necessários: Nenhum.

Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Rags
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags
race.name: Goblin

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.

EN:
Random resource component allows placing multiple new entities in range, randomly during world generation.
[color=192,176,27,255]Entities[/color] are a list entities that may spawn on the spot.
[color=192,176,27,255]Spawn at entities[/color] is optional and may restrict where entities will spawn - for example spawn the entities only on grass tiles.
[color=192,176,27,255]Amount between[/color] defines range that will be used to generate the count of the entities.
[color=192,176,27,255]Distance between[/color] defines distance in tiles (radius) that can be used to define position where entity should spawn.
[color=192,176,27,255]Spawn chance[/color] determines the chance (0.01 = 1%) for entity to spawn at selected spot during world generation.
[color=192,176,27,255]Spawn rolls[/color] determines how many times the spawn attempt should be repeated.
[color=192,176,27,255]Respawn rate[/color] defines time required to another spawn. If not set the spawn happens only during new world generation.
[color=192,176,27,255]Multiply chance[/color] defines percentage (0.01 = 1%) chance to spawn extra entity into adjacent tile.
[color=192,176,27,255]Multiply same[/color] when checked forces the adjacent tile spawn to be exactly the same as the first rolled.

Required components: Name.
PTBR:
Componente de recurso aleatório permite posicionar múltiplas novas entidades no alcance, aleatoriamente durante a geração de mundo.
[color=192,176,27,255]Entidades[/color] são uma lista de entidades que podem surgir no local.
[color=192,176,27,255]Surgir em entidades[/color] é opcional e pode restringir onde as entidades surgirão — por exemplo, fazer as entidades surgirem apenas em quadrados de grama.
[color=192,176,27,255]Quantidade entre[/color] define o intervalo que será usado para gerar a contagem das entidades.
[color=192,176,27,255]Distância entre[/color] define a distância em quadrados (raio) que pode ser usada para definir a posição onde a entidade deve surgir.
[color=192,176,27,255]Chance de surgimento[/color] determina a chance (0.01 = 1%) para a entidade surgir no local selecionado durante a geração de mundo.
[color=192,176,27,255]Tentativas de surgimento[/color] determina quantas vezes a tentativa de surgimento deve ser repetida.
[color=192,176,27,255]Taxa de ressurgimento[/color] define o tempo necessário para outro surgimento. Se não definido, o surgimento ocorre apenas durante a geração de novo mundo.
[color=192,176,27,255]Multiplicar chance[/color] define a porcentagem (0.01 = 1%) de chance de surgir uma entidade extra em quadrado adjacente.
[color=192,176,27,255]Multiplicar igual[/color] quando marcado força o surgimento no quadrado adjacente a ser exatamente o mesmo do primeiro sorteado.

Componentes obrigatórios: Nome.

Resurrector component resurrects the entity. For player, it will resurrect in the starting location. If the component is on item, the effect will apply to the owner. Item will be destroyed upon resurrecting the actor. If this component is on Actor, there's no limit to resurrections making the entity immortal.

Required components: Position2D, Name, Item or Actor.

O componente Ressuscitador ressuscita a entidade. Para o jogador, ele ressuscitará no local inicial. Se o componente estiver em um item, o efeito será aplicado ao proprietário. O item será destruído ao ressuscitar o ator. Se este componente estiver no Ator, não há limite de ressurreições, tornando a entidade imortal.

Componentes necessários: Position2D, Nome, Item ou Ator.

EN:
Statistics like Strength, Dexterity, Endurance, Intelligence, and Willpower apply to a multitude of systems in Soulash, for more information check New Game Screen, or Character Sheet in-game. Statistics apply to items and actors. When the Statistics component combines with the Item component, statistic values add to the entity that wears the item. A range of values determines every statistic in this component. During world generation, an algorithm determines a value between the two assigned here.

Required components: Item or Actor, Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
Estatísticas como Força, Destreza, Resistência, Inteligência e Força de Vontade se aplicam a uma multiplicidade de sistemas em Soulash; para mais informações, verifique a Tela de Novo Jogo ou a Ficha de Personagem no jogo. As estatísticas se aplicam a itens e atores. Quando o componente de Estatísticas se combina com o componente de Item, os valores das estatísticas são adicionados à entidade que equipa o item. Um intervalo de valores determina cada estatística neste componente. Durante a geração de mundo, um algoritmo determina um valor entre os dois atribuídos aqui.

Componentes necessários: Item ou Ator, Position2D, Name.

EN:
Tags define multiple things in the game. They mark entities, and ability effects may trigger based on selected tags. During world generation, entities have races assigned based on these tags. The chosen race may then replace 'Placeholder' description procedurally.

Required components: Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
Marcadores definem várias coisas no jogo. Eles marcam entidades, e efeitos de habilidades podem ser acionados com base nos marcadores selecionados. Durante a geração de mundo, entidades têm raças atribuídas com base nesses marcadores. A raça escolhida pode então substituir a descrição 'Placeholder' proceduralmente.

Componentes necessários: Position2D, Name.

[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

EN:
Liquid in Soulash can have two states. One state is a liquid inside a container - it can be drunk or used for cleaning. The other state is covering other entities - in which case the entity may turn into another entity. A blood entity is an actual example with five different entities that get replaced through this component. [color=192,176,27,255]After limit[/color] of liquid is reached the entity gets [color=192,176,27,255]swapped to[/color] selected entity. The covered liquids have percentage values between 1 and 100, while liquid sources measure their limit in consumable units.

Required components: Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
Líquidos em Soulash podem ter dois estados. Um estado é um líquido dentro de um recipiente — pode ser bebido ou usado para limpeza. O outro estado é cobrir outras entidades — caso em que a entidade pode se transformar em outra. Uma entidade de sangue é um exemplo real com cinco entidades diferentes que são substituídas por este componente. [color=192,176,27,255]Após o limite[/color] de líquido ser atingido, a entidade é [color=192,176,27,255]trocada para[/color] a entidade selecionada. Líquidos cobertos têm valores percentuais entre 1 e 100, enquanto fontes de líquido medem seu limite em unidades consumíveis.

Componentes obrigatórios: Position2D, Nome.

[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. EN:
Water component allows the use of 'fishing' skill on the entity to catch fish. [color=192,176,27,255]Swimming[/color] field is currently not used in-game, but will determine if passing the tile requires swimming which will introduce new mechanics in the future. [color=192,176,27,255]Fishing[/color] field toggles the ability to catch fish. [color=192,176,27,255]Fishing during the day and night[/color] determine what kind of fishes can be caught on the tile during certain parts of the day.

Required components: Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
O componente Água permite o uso da habilidade 'pesca' na entidade para pescar peixes. O campo [color=192,176,27,255]Natação[/color] não é usado no jogo no momento, mas determinará se atravessar o quadrado exigirá natação, o que introduzirá novas mecânicas no futuro. O campo [color=192,176,27,255]Pesca[/color] alterna a capacidade de pescar peixes. [color=192,176,27,255]Pesca durante o dia e a noite[/color] determinam que tipo de peixes pode ser pescado no quadrado durante certas partes do dia.

Componentes necessários: Position2D, Name.

EN:
Weapon component can be assigned to entity to create a damage dealing item. All weapons should have a selected [color=192,176,27,255]type[/color] that determine hit chance calculation from wielder statistics for example.
[color=192,176,27,255]Two-handed[/color] checkbox will block the second hand when weapon is wielded.
[color=192,176,27,255]Range[/color] higher than 1 allows entities to use 'shoot' action that may either throw the weapon or use ammunition to make a ranged attack.
[color=192,176,27,255]Speed[/color] defines how long in turns an attack action will require time. The standard speed is 1.0 which is equal to a turn, but the speed can take a decimal time. For example many daggers have 0.8 attack speed.
Every point of [color=192,176,27,255]hit bonus[/color] increases the sum of hit chance by 10%, while every point of [color=192,176,27,255]parry bonus[/color] reduce the chance of successful incoming hits by 10%. [color=192,176,27,255]Attack animation[/color] allows assigning unique animations for attacks done with the weapon.

Required components: Item, Position2D, Name.
PTBR:
O componente de arma pode ser atribuído a uma entidade para criar um item que causa dano. Todas as armas devem ter um [color=192,176,27,255]tipo[/color] selecionado que determina o cálculo da chance de acerto a partir das estatísticas do portador, por exemplo.
[color=192,176,27,255]Duas mãos[/color] a caixa de seleção bloqueará a segunda mão quando a arma for empunhada.
[color=192,176,27,255]Alcance[/color] maior que 1 permite que as entidades usem a ação 'atirar' que pode lançar a arma ou usar munição para fazer um ataque à distância.
[color=192,176,27,255]Velocidade[/color] define quanto tempo em turnos uma ação de ataque exigirá. A velocidade padrão é 1.0 que equivale a um turno, mas a velocidade pode assumir um tempo decimal. Por exemplo, muitas adagas têm velocidade de ataque 0.8.
Cada ponto de [color=192,176,27,255]bônus de acerto[/color] aumenta a soma da chance de acerto em 10%, enquanto cada ponto de [color=192,176,27,255]bônus de aparo[/color] reduz a chance de acertos inimigos bem-sucedidos em 10%. [color=192,176,27,255]Animação de ataque[/color] permite atribuir animações únicas para ataques feitos com a arma.

Componentes necessários: Item, Position2D, Name.

They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

PTBR:
Peso maior torna os itens mais difíceis de pegar. Também afeta o consumo de vigor ao arrastar o item.

Componentes necessários: Item, Position2D, Nome.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2

[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.

[color=155,155,155,255]Orcs are green. Orcs are mean. Orcs want to smash, bash and eat. They form hordes led by the most brutal chieftains of their kind to raid other races for loot. Their physical appearance is second only to trolls and giants.[/color]

Strength +2, Endurance +2
Hit bonus +1 on all weapons

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Hand axe
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Hatchet
race.name: Orc

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Liches are powerful mages that cheated death. There are not many of them in the world, but most are immensely powerful. Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Quarterstaff
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask
race.name: Lich

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger, Shirt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger
race.name: Rasimi

EN: Press `::rest_key` to wait for a turn. This action will regain stamina at the cost of fatigue if possible. You can rest with max stamina to pass 1 turn.
PTBR: Pressione `::rest_key` para esperar um turno. Esta ação recupera Vigor ao custo de fadiga, se possível. Você pode descansar com Vigor máximo para passar 1 turno.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Knife, Bandage
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Fishing rod
race.name: Human

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.
Tinkerer: double chance to learn new recipe when salvaging.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Pickaxe, Belt
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Pickaxe
race.name: Dark dwarf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Rags
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags
race.name: Goblin

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

Their center of power is in the Black Pyramid of Sareth where God Pharaoh Sandaver rules over the dead. The power that allows these beings to defy death is shrouded in mystery.[/color]

Intelligence +2, Willpower +2
Thirst and hunger is replaced by life essence.
Death aura dealing 1 death damage to everything nearby every turn.

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Mask

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Rasimi are cat-like people. They are many sub-races among them, having common parts with lions, panthers, tigers or regular house cats. They live deep in the jungles of Tar'Var. They are individuals, loners and prefer seclusion over contact with others, as they considering other races untrustworthy. The feeling is often mutual.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Strength +1, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Move 10% faster

[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Dagger

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Humans were the most common being in the world once, but these days are long gone. The population decimated by constant wars is now just a shadow of its former glory. Representatives of this race are extremely adaptable to the situation, but their history was marked heavily by external influence. As the War of Worlds has ended, a great empire has been formed, where single human family clings to the seat of power to this day.[/color]

All statistics +1
Gets hungry 50% slower

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Dark dwarves are a subrace of dwarves completely corrupted by greed. They prefer to build their incredible keeps very deep below the ground or near volcanoes. Beings of these race are known for being cruel and malevolent.[/color]

Endurance +2
Willpower +2
Infravision: see in the dark.
Tinkerer: double chance to learn new recipe when salvaging.

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Goblins are small greenskin creatures known for their ruthlessness. Some say they are shorter orc cousins. They form tribes and prefer to live in the mountains. Their greed pushes them to challenge dwarves for their territory constantly. From time to time, they organize in hordes that swarm even the human empire.[/color]

Dexterity +3, Endurance +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sneaking +10

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Rags
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Rags

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]A long time ago dark elves were living in the forests with their brethren, but they were corrupted by dark gods. Now they occupy huge underground cities. Their controversial religious practices and rituals make them feared and dreaded. They despise most other races for opposing their rightful place among them.[/color]

Dexterity +2, Intelligence +1, Willpower +1
Infravision: see in the dark.
Sight range +1

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Dagger
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Short bow
race.name: Dark elf

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Vampires are dead beings of living races, cursed to wander the world till the end of times. They don't eat regular food and don't drink water. They feed by drinking the blood of the living to sustain their immortal bodies. Vampires have formed an enclave in the ruins of Black Sun Castle, where they scheme to take over the world and enslave the living like cattle.[/color]

Strength +1, Endurance +2, Intelligence +1
Thirst and hunger is replaced by bloodlust.
Infravision: see in the dark.

[color=130,163,175,255]Items:[/color] Cloak, Hood
[color=130,163,175,255]Recipes:[/color] Cloak

race.description:
[color=155,155,155,255]Trolls are huge humanoid beasts. Not many beings of this race are considered smart, but they make up for it with brutal, physical power. Trolls have the strength to tear smaller beings apart in the blink of an eye. They are forever hungry and possess very potent regenerative powers.[/color]

Strength +3, Endurance +1, Intelligence -2
Regenerates health 20% faster.
Gets hungry 50% faster.
